description: Quote and ready-to-sign transaction to move value between Solana, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC and Avalanche, any token to any token, through the deBridge Liquidity Network (solver-filled, typically under a minute). Tokens by symbol or address; amount in human units. Without sender you get the quote; with sender and recipient you also get the exact transaction, the ERC-20 approval it needs, an order id and the status link. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

amount.description: Amount to send in human units, e.g. 25 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to send in base units

from_chain.description: Source chain: solana, base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

input.description: Token to send: symbol or address on the source chain

output.description: Token to receive: symbol or address on the destination chain

recipient.description: Wallet that receives on the destination chain (default sender when both chains share the address format)

sender.description: Wallet that signs and pays on the source chain; omit for a quote only
